description: The production site is the app; it may push timer state, start a browser sign-in, and listen for shell events. Nothing else. Note what is NOT here: no opener grant. The shell launches the sign-in URL itself from Rust (tauri_plugin_opener::open_url is a plain function call that never crosses IPC and never consults this file), so the page is given no way to make the shell launch anything at all — not even a chroneli.com URL. See begin_browser_login in src/lib.rs and the_acl_withholds_what_a_plain_browser_tab_could_not_do.
